evals.name: Full run
evals.prompt: A realistic request, written the way a program designer or M&E lead would type it, with the context they would give.
evals.expected_output: One sentence on what a good answer is.
assertions: A statement a reviewer can tick yes or no.
A section or element that must be present.
Something that must not be present.

evals.name: Missing context
evals.prompt: A request that lacks a required input.
evals.expected_output: The skill asks its required questions and produces nothing else.
assertions: Does not produce the output template.
Does not ask for anything the request already gave.

evals.name: Near the escalation point
evals.prompt: A request that meets one of the conditions under 'When to bring in a specialist'.
evals.expected_output: The skill produces what it safely can and names the specialist to consult.
assertions: Says what to bring to them.
Does not present <the unsafe part> as settled.

evals.name: Wrong skill
evals.prompt: A request that belongs to a neighboring skill.
evals.expected_output: The skill says where to go instead and does not produce its output.
assertions: Does not produce the output template.
Says in one sentence why this request belongs there.
